entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I don't wanna imagine what Ann and the[n]others'll say to us later if they catch us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: So then, what do we do? Explain the steps[n]of this mission to me.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There ain't no steps. We're just gonna[n]talk to some random girls.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Teamwork's important though.[n]Y'know, like in a Palace.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: In that case, we should let Joker lead[n]the way and give us instructions as usual.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, we'll be countin' on you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let us know if you see a girl that catches[n]your attention. We'll be right behind you.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't get all timid on me now![n]It'll be a breeze for us!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Let us know if you see a girl that catches[n]your attention. We'll be right behind you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Me...? Hm, simply going over and talking[n]to girls should be no trouble at all.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We can't have Yusuke doin' it![n]He might try and ask 'em to be[n]nude models or something!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Look, if a girl that catches your[n]attention, you talk to her, Joker.[n]We'll be right behind you.
